title: ba-brief INDEX manifest (stage artifact of ba-research)
description: Target-owned schema for the 3-level ref-chain manifest (INDEX.json -> epic sidecars -> story sidecars) that the ba-research stage emits as its artifact. The engine hydrates epics[].file / story_files[].file into inline sidecar objects for consumers (mapping.py _hydrate_ba_research) and ADDS `stories` alongside the retained `story_files` refs. Currently validated boundary-only at runtime (engine exemption); this schema documents the dialect and enables a future exemption removal.

audit_id.description: Same producer-stamped value as the canonical brief: UUIDv5(HOUSE_NS, "ba-research:{idempotency_key}"); independent of the optional discovery input.

state.description: TL readiness signal — tl-design's pre-flight requires ready-for-tl.

discovery_file.description: Relative ref to the S1a discovery artifact (null when the optional discovery input was absent).

file.description: Manifest-relative POSIX ref to the epic sidecar; engine-hydrated inline for consumers.
Manifest-relative POSIX ref to the story sidecar; engine-hydrated into the added `stories` key.
